narr: Scattered thunderstorms produced heavy rain during the morning and afternoon of August 7th, which caused localized flooding.
ev: Water was reported over Karlov Road.
Flooding caused 167th Street to be closed. Side roads were likely flooded as well. Rainfall of 3.06 inches was measured in Oak Forest.
lsr: 167TH STREET CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING. SIDE ROADS LIKELY FLOODED AS WELL.
POLICE DEPARTMENT REPORTED WATER OVER KARLOV AVENUE. TIME IS ESTIMATED FROM RADAR.
